heading: UK to introduce special rape and serious sexual offence courts, amid low prosecution rate
author: Times of India Editorial
paragraphs: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham announced dedicated courts for sexual offence cases. These new courts aim to expedite convictions and reduce case backlogs significantly.  Specialized training will be provided to court personnel for handling sensitive cases.  Victims will receive a dedicated point of contact throughout the legal process.  This initiative supports the government's commitment to reducing violence against women.
